description: The Proportional Pivot: High-fidelity dashboard of Victorian supply shift (2012-2025).
methodology: Data Engineering: Implemented a High-Resolution Linear Interpolation model in Python, expanding the 8-year record to 130 discrete time-steps (0.1 year resolution) to achieve 'liquid' visual transitions. Extrapolation Logic: For the post-2022 recovery era, 2022-23 baselines were extrapolated to 2025 to visualize the 'Return to Safety' in a complete circular narrative. Global Control: Integrated a 'showModern' parameter to synchronize the 2022-2025 revelation across the entire Engineering section.
citation: Victorian State Government. (2026). Victorian Water Accounts: Total use by resource. Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action.
